content: Remain in wonder if you want the mysteries to open up for you. Mysteries never open up to those who go on questioning.
author: Osho
sourceWork: Freedom: The Courage to Be Yourself
story:
Rather than offering a polite platitude, this observation challenges how we navigate our inner lives. Thinking about doing something gives us a comfortable dopamine hit of progress without any of the actual friction. We often use over-researching and planning as socially acceptable disguises for fear of starting.

Across his life and work, Osho saw how easily we surrender our tranquility to fear, vanity, and distraction. Clarity follows action; it does not precede it. You cannot think your way into a new way of living—you have to act your way into a new way of understanding. The smallest real-world step beats the most brilliant theory.
reflectionPrompt: How can you integrate the essence of this wisdom into one specific decision or encounter today?
